short: Outdoors Went Outside. It Was Fine.
twin: the source print (unisex-outdoors-went-outside-it-was-fine-heavyweight-hoodie, 3365 x 3687, a Sandstone print) had WENT OUTSIDE. in a heavy serif above the art and IT WAS FINE. in a slab below, clean row gaps either side of the mountain-lake art (rows 341-3279 kept; its own grunge edge is part of the art, no straight cut edge); both lines were cropped away and re-set. The art reads on light and dark blanks, so one art file serves both.
